title: Icon adherence probe refuses ship on inline SVG or unknown alias
asA: operator relying on the iconography discipline
iWant: a runtime check that fails the build when a component sidesteps the icon alias registry
soThat: the one-icon-set-behind-semantic-aliases contract in ADR-206 is enforced at the ship gate, not just declared

acceptanceCriteria.description: The icon-adherence probe (TAC-208) scans the shipped component source tree and exits non-zero when any file outside the icon registry allow list contains an inline `<svg>` opening tag.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project source tree in which a component ships an inline `<svg>` element outside the icon registry
acceptanceCriteria.when: the icon-adherence probe runs against the component glob
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe exits with a non-zero code and records the file path and line number of the inline SVG in its report

acceptanceCriteria.description: The icon-adherence probe reads the icon alias registry, enumerates the declared alias names, and exits non-zero when any component-source icon reference resolves to a name absent from the registry.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a component that references `icon.close` while the alias registry declares only `icon.danger`, `icon.search`, and `icon.menu`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the icon-adherence probe runs against the component glob
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe exits with a non-zero code and records the unknown alias name, file path, and line number in its report

acceptanceCriteria.description: The icon-adherence probe writes a JSON report at a stable relative path (`reports/icon-adherence.json` under the configured report directory) naming every component file scanned, every inline-SVG violation, every unknown-alias violation, and an `ok` or `fail` verdict.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a completed probe run (pass or fail)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the report file is inspected on disk
acceptanceCriteria.then: the JSON at `reports/icon-adherence.json` matches the shape declared by TAC-208 and its verdict field agrees with the process exit code

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the icon-adherence probe is wired as a gate in the ci-pipeline runner (TAC-701), a non-zero probe exit propagates through the per-gate report (TAC-702) and the aggregate report (TAC-703), and the ci-pipeline runner refuses ship with a non-zero exit.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the ci-pipeline runner configured with the icon-adherence probe as a required gate
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe reports `fail` on any run
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate report records the gate as failed and the runner exits non-zero
